corrections: Added OwnerRefusalWitness, a token-guarded record that only the capture functions can produce.

capture_empirical_integrity_refusal() invokes type(original_object) itself - the class comes from a genuine owner-produced object, never from the caller - then derives refused_ref from that object's own sealed .ref and supporting_refs from its own authority/dependency/replay bindings.
capture_required_authority_refusal() imports and calls the real execute_exact_bounded_discovery itself; the owner function is never caller-supplied.
Both captures catch ONLY the exact expected refusal type and bind invocation_binding = semantic_hash(exact owner-call inputs).

from_empirical_integrity_refusal(witness=...) and from_blocked_authority_refusal(witness=...) now accept a witness ONLY. The exception, producer_ref, supporting_refs and reason parameters were REMOVED, so a caller cannot independently choose the retained state, the producer/input ref, the supporting refs, or the owner label.
If the owner ACCEPTS the input there is no refusal: absence of refusal is never converted into a governed state.
Removed the reviewer's stale short-circuited coverage_custody.completeness_state branch, which referenced a field removed in R2 and would have raised AttributeError. Handoff semantics are unchanged.
